summary_1line: A mongoose recounts how a poor Brahmana’s sincere gift outweighed a grand sacrifice, teaching that devotion and righteousness surpass wealth and ritual.

image_candidates.scene_text: A half‑golden mongoose stands among astonished Brahmanas at a royal horse sacrifice, its body gleaming as it speaks of a poor Brahmana’s humble gift.
The impoverished Brahmana offers his last handful of powdered barley and water to a guest while his family watches in hunger inside a bare hut.
A celestial chariot descends amid falling flowers as the deity of Righteousness invites the Brahmana and his family to ascend to Heaven.
